scope: Frozen final deployed EXE with GDN/QSA Q8 tail enabled; later source-only WG128 change is not included
timing: Native engine DONE times, fresh prompt, no prompt reuse/offload. Initial request per case retained separately. Warmups are not discarded from evidence. Short=28 prompt tokens and76 output tokens; other cases=2048/2048/8000 prompt and128 output. Repeated prompts adapt expert placement, so cold/warm/range must be reported separately. Quiet logging on. Accepted/offered includes suffix lookup.
runtime_gates: Same actual cache capacity and output hashes, no tracked competing GPU/build activity, outer baseline median drift<=3%, each case gain>=-2%, aggregate>=1%. Screen alone never authorizes production adoption.
model_identity_check: Model file sizes and mtimes compared before/after; full weight files not rehashed.
warmup_counts: production-auto:10 short/3 other warmups then5 measured. Runtime/profiler:2 warmups then3 measured per case. Confidence:3 A warmups then8 alternating measurements per case (4 per condition). All warmups preserved.

ezpp_comparison.screen_passed_note: The >=1% speedup screen applies to optimization candidates; profiler overhead validity uses capacity/output equality and <=3% baseline drift.

excluded_initial_fixed_baseline.reason: External compiler and GPU parity activity during this arm. Entire arm excluded before any candidate ran; raw record retained locally.

excluded_first_warm_followup.reason: External compiler activity during this cohort. Entire cohort excluded and repeated with exactly the same plan; no outcome-based exclusions.
